verdict.rationale: For a coding agent, acting as an MCP client is a fair axis, but nothing in the evidence pack mentions connecting MCP servers. The closest items are adjacent and earn no credit: ACPAgent uses Agent Client Protocol servers as an agent backend (a different protocol and role), and the SDK custom-tools system and AgentSkills are developer building blocks, not MCP server plug-in support.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
